items.title: Internal Auditor
items.location_text: Europe, Poland, Remote - Slovakia, Remote — Romania, Lithuania, Latvia, Ukraine, Estonia, Limassol, Slovenia
items.description: Remote | EU/EEA | Regulated Crypto & Payments Company | Part-time B2B Consultancy About the Client Our client is a global fintech company operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It serves millions of users worldwide through two business lines: a B2C retail platform for buying, selling, and swapping crypto, and B2B infrastructure providing on/off-ramp APIs, payouts, and compliance infrastructure for fintechs, wallets, and platforms. The company's EU operating entity holds a MiCA CASP authorisation and a Payment Institution licence under PSD2, serving EU customers and powering a regulated B2B platform that fintechs, neobanks, PSPs, and Web3 companies build on - under the company's licences. Its control environment is part of the product, not back-office overhead. About the Role The company is looking for an Internal Auditor to run the third line of defence for its EU-licensed entity. This is not a compliance role and not a monitoring role with an audit title. You audit Compliance controls - you do not execute them. You report functionally to the Management Board, you set your own severity ratings, and you deliver findings to the people who run the company, including when the finding is about them. The function already exists. The Charter, Audit Universe, Internal Audit Plan and findings register are in place and Board-approved. This is not a rebuild of the methodology - it is delivering the plan with rigour, keeping the register alive and closed out with evidence, and putting the Board and the supervisor in a position where the control environment can be answered from the file. - What You'll Do Own and maintain the risk-based Internal Audit Plan across MiCA CASP and PSD2 PI obligations, AML/KYC/CTF controls, ICT and security (DORA), custody and segregation of client assets, safeguarding of client funds, outsourcing and third-party risk, governance and financial controls. - Execute engagements end-to-end - design the programme, select samples, test controls, rate severity and regulatory impact. - Write Board-ready audit reports with findings that hold up under challenge and recommendations someone can actually act on. - Obtain remediation plans with named owners and deadlines; track and verify closure against evidence, not assertion. - Present findings and remediation status to the Management Board - quarterly updates and the annual Internal Audit Report. - Deliver the annual independent AML/CFT audit and the DORA ICT framework audit and follow-up. - Scope, direct, and challenge external specialists where an engagement needs deep technical testing. - Maintain the audit evidence that supports regulatory supervisory reviews and inspections. What We're Looking For Required - 5+ years of internal audit or internal control experience in a regulated financial services entity - bank, payment institution, EMI, investment firm, insurer, regulated fintech or crypto/VASP. Unregulated-only experience will not be considered. - Hands-on audit experience with at least one fintech, payment institution, EMI, crypto exchange or VASP - execution, not advisory theory. - Working knowledge of at least two of MiCA, PSD2, AMLD5/6 and DORA, with the ability to turn a regulatory obligation into a test programme. - Strong understanding of AML/KYC/CTF frameworks and how to audit their effectiveness. - Evidence of independence in practice - critical findings delivered to senior management or a Board and held under challenge. - Ability to run an engagement unsupervised and to make and defend a professional judgement on control severity. - Sufficient ICT and information security audit literacy to scope a DORA engagement and to direct and challenge an external technical specialist. - Fluent professional English - reports go to the Board and to the regulator as written. - Hands-on use of AI tools in audit work - planning, analysis, testing or reporting - with concrete examples. - Right to work and tax residence in the EU/EEA, with eligibility to be appointed to an internal control function of a licensed entity. Nice to Have - MiCA CASP post-authorisation audit experience. - PSD2 / EMI safeguarding, own funds and scheme-compliance audit experience. - Deep ICT / information security audit capability, including DLT infrastructure, wallet security and key management. - DORA operational resilience, outsourcing and third-party risk audit experience. - Custody and segregation-of-client-assets audit experience. - Travel rule (FATF / EU TFR) audit experience. - Experience with a Baltic or other EU financial supervisor. - Board- or regulator-facing communication experience. - CIA, CISA, ACCA or an EU-recognised internal audit qualification. - Russian or Latvian. What Makes This Role Different - This role is for auditors who want real independence, not a compliance review with an audit title. - You inherit a working function - Charter, plan, universe, and findings register already exist and are Board-approved - and you run it, not rebuild it from scratch. - You report functionally to the Board, set your own severity ratings, and deliver findings directly to the people who can act on them, including senior leadership. - You'll work across one of the more complex dual-licensed perimeters in Europe (MiCA CASP + PSD2 PI), with direct Board access and budget for external technical specialists where needed. Working Environment - Remote across the EU/EEA, with periodic in-person days at the company's EU office (roughly quarterly, or around Board meetings). - Part-time engagement (~0.5 FTE), B2B consultancy contract. - Functional reporting to the Management Board; no team, no review layer - full ownership of the function. - Scheduled checkpoints at scope memo, draft report and Board reporting stages; no involvement from management in fieldwork, findings or ratings.

items.title: VP, Customer Success - Betting & Gaming
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com. We’re looking for enthusiastic and ambitious people to join our talented team. If you see yourself becoming part of a global family building the future of sports entertainment together, then come and grow with us. We put trust in our people to deliver the difference for our clients around the world. It’s why many of the world’s largest leagues & federations such as the NFL, English Premier League, FIBA and NCAA choose to work with Genius Sports. The Role: Genius Sports is transforming how advertisers connect with sports fans through official data, real-time contextual targeting, and premium media solutions. We are seeking a senior executive to lead our Customer Success organization, overseeing both our global agency partnerships and our brand-direct managed service teams. In this role, you will oversee post-sales success across our betting and gaming ad business, driving adoption of our unique Ad Tech capabilities across the biggest casino and sportsbook brands in the market. You will shape the strategy, scale the team globally, and drive commercial outcomes that position Genius Sports as the leading partner for data-driven sports advertising. As part of the senior leadership team, you will play a pivotal role in guiding the company’s growth, deepening customer relationships, and elevating how our gaming partners engage audiences across the global sports ecosystem. What You'll Do: Strategic Leadership Define and oversee a unified post-sales strategy that supports the company’s commercial objectives across the betting and gaming vertical. Develop a holistic customer lifecycle model that enhances onboarding, adoption, performance, and long-term partnership value. Executive Oversight & Organizational Management Directly manage senior team leads providing leadership, coaching, and strategic direction. Establish clear goals, KPIs, and performance frameworks for both teams, ensuring consistency in operational excellence, client satisfaction, and revenue outcomes. Scale the combined organization globally, identifying structure, talent needs, and resource allocation to support growth across markets. Commercial Growth & Revenue Leadership Own aggregate revenue goals across the entire post-sales portfolio, including retention, upsell, managed service revenue, and multi-market expansion. Partner with Sales leadership to build a seamless pre-to-post-sales motion that accelerates time-to-value and increases platform stickiness. Champion the adoption of Genius Sports’s advertising capabilities & educate partners on how to integrate these capabilities into media plans, trading strategies and testing frameworks. Cross-Functional Partnership & Influence Act as the senior voice of the customer—advocating for customer needs across Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Ad Operations. Collaborate with the Product organization to prioritize roadmaps around audience capabilities, contextual triggers, measurement, and managed-service tools. Partner with Marketing to develop enterprise-level thought leadership, case studies, and education programs targeting both brands and agencies. Work closely with Ad Operations to support operational excellence, forecasting, and campaign delivery across all managed services. Work collaboratively with Genius Sports teams across the betting and gaming ecosystem to ensure advertising solutions align with wider commercial objectives. Operational Excellence & Global Scale Establish processes for onboarding, campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and renewal across both divisions. Implement dashboards and analytics that give executive-level visibility into customer health, campaign performance, and revenue trends. Drive continuous improvement and automation initiatives that increase efficiency and scalability across markets and product lines. What You'll Bring: 12+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Agency Partnerships, or Commercial Leadership within Ad Tech, MarTech, media, or data-driven advertising. Deep understanding of programmatic media, sports marketing, data targeting, and cross-channel activation. Proven track record of building and scaling global teams, driving retention, and managing multimillion-dollar portfolios. Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders at global holding companies and C-suite brand marketers. Analytical, data-driven, highly collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Experience working within or closely alongside the betting and gaming industry, with an understanding of its compliance landscape, marketing restrictions, and unique audience dynamics. The salary for this role is based on an annualized range of $180,000 - $220,000 USD. In addition to base salary, this role will be eligible to participate in Genius Sports variable compensation schemes, as well as our US benefits and 401k plans. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports. Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Prime
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Prime team 's mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms onboard, fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book — together with the client- and ops-facing surfaces that make them usable, from institutional onboarding and account configuration to reporting and the backoffice tooling our operations run on every day. These are correctness-critical systems where a wrong answer can't be cheaply undone — getting them right is the whole job. As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will own the design and end-to-end delivery of features across that whole surface — from the Prime backend services down to the frontend and backoffice screens that expose them. You'll lead other engineers through problems of high ambiguity, set the technical bar for how we build for failure and not just the happy path, and follow a problem across the full institutional lifecycle rather than stopping at a boundary. Flexibility is the job: some weeks that's a settlement edge case in the backend, others a client onboarding flow or an ops dashboard, and you're happy owning whichever the work needs. This role is based in our Ljubljana, Slovenia office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. Applications for this role will be accepted through October 30, 2026. Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs. What you’ll do Lead the design and end-to-end delivery of features across the stack — from Prime backend services (settlement, on-exchange credit, lending, tokenized securities) through to the frontend and backoffice screens clients and ops teams rely on. Own the client- and ops-facing journeys across the institutional lifecycle — onboarding, account configuration, reporting, and the tooling that lets operations run the business safely. Author detailed designs and break work into reviewable steps, making failure states, invariants, and recovery explicit before you ship — on flows where a wrong answer moves real money. Uplevel the team through design-focused code review and mentorship, and move fluidly between backend and frontend as the work demands rather than handing off at a boundary. What you bring A track record of independently delivering complex, high-ambiguity projects with long-term impact, operating them in production and owning every line you ship. Strong full-stack range in production — a modern backend (we work primarily in Python/Django and Go) and a component-based frontend (we use Vue) — with the judgment to know where a given problem is best solved and a genuine willingness to own whatever the feature needs, wherever it lives in the stack. Hands-on experience building financial systems — user balances, ledgers, risk engines, settlement, onboarding/KYC, or payments — where correctness is non-negotiable and mistakes are expensive. Strong design judgment: you enumerate the failure paths, name your invariants, and can point at the constraint, test, or alert that enforces each one. Excellent communication: you drive alignment across teams and stakeholders, give substantive design-level review feedback, and mentor engineers to raise the bar around you. 🎁 What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career and build cutting-edge financial infrastructure. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact and discretionary bonus programs. Top-tier supplemental insurance benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary medical insurance, and mental health support programs Lifestyle Wallet: A highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account to offset expenses like wellness, learning, childcare, and more Access to the best AI tools on the market with continuous AI skill-building opportunities for all employees Time to recharge: Generous paid time off, Slovenian public holidays, sick time, parental leave, and paid volunteer time off. Commuter Stipend: Monthly employer-paid allowance to offset in-office commuting costs Exceptional office experience: Catered meals, team parties, and comfortable, collaborative workspaces in our Ljubljana office Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. THE OPPORTUNITY - Build and scale a KOL/creator network in the Netherlands, Germany and other countries for Kraken Pro from the ground up - Drive new trading user acquisition through influencer and creator partnerships across both markets - Own end-to-end relationship management with local KOLs, from sourcing to activation - Represent Kraken Pro's derivatives suite — perpetual futures, prop trading, margin — to top regional creators - Fix on-the-ground execution issues that block program performance and iterate fast - Set and own regional KOL acquisition targets and CAC efficiency [A] - Partner cross-functionally with growth, marketing, and compliance teams - Benchmark and adapt a proven KOL playbook WHAT YOU BRING - Proven track record building an influencer/KOL/creator network from scratch in the Netherlands and/or Germany - Native or fluent Dutch and/or German, deep fluency in the local crypto/trading creator ecosystem - Experience acquiring trading users at scale with a clear eye on CAC - Hands-on, get-shit-done approach — solves problems on the ground rather than escalating - High agency — owns regional strategy without waiting for global direction - Understanding of perpetual futures, margin, and prop trading products - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous, 24/7 crypto environment - Strong relationship-management and negotiation skills with creators/KOLs NICE TO HAVES - Existing personal network of crypto KOLs/creators in NL/DE and other countries - Prior KOL, growth, or influencer marketing role at a crypto exchange Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. items.title: Strategic Delivery Lead, Department of Energy & Science
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The OpenAI for Government team brings frontier AI to public institutions to help them achieve their missions. We partner with government leaders, scientists, and technical teams to deploy AI tools responsibly, with the reliability, security, and support needed for meaningful use. Our Energy & Science pod supports the Department of Energy (DOE), U.S. national laboratories, and the broader federal science community, including NASA and the National Science Foundation (NSF). We help these institutions apply frontier AI to scientific research, engineering, and mission operations through hands-on delivery, tailored enablement, and collaboration between researchers. ABOUT THE ROLE The Strategic Delivery Lead, Department of Energy & Science, will shape and deliver high-impact AI engagements across DOE headquarters and the U.S. national laboratory ecosystem. You will turn customer priorities into practical deployments and sustained use, helping scientists and mission teams apply OpenAI technology to research, scientific computing, knowledge discovery, and operational workflows. This individual contributor role reports to the leader of Federal Civilian and State & Local Government. You will work alongside the pod’s Account Director and Applied AI Architect, coordinating Research, Product, Engineering, Policy, Security, and Enablement resources. The Account Director owns commercial strategy, contracts, and quota; you own delivery coordination, adoption, and customer outcomes, without an individual sales quota. You will lead execution across customer and OpenAI workstreams: define scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and success measures; surface risks; resolve blockers; and communicate progress to researchers, lab directors, and DOE leadership. You are accountable for agreed delivery commitments and customer acceptance. Engineering and Product teams remain responsible for technical implementation and operation of the systems they own. This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role combining senior relationship leadership with hands-on execution. Success requires sound judgment, technical fluency, strong program management, and the ability to turn executive alignment into useful technology in scientists’ hands. This role is based in Washington, DC, with domestic travel for high-value customer engagements, workshops, and delivery milestones. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build trusted relationships with DOE leadership, lab directors, research leaders, and technical and mission teams to identify priorities and turn senior alignment into actionable engagements. - Own delivery plans for assigned DOE and national lab engagements, with clear milestones, accountable owners, customer acceptance criteria, and measurable scientific or operational outcomes. - Translate research and mission needs into requirements and decisions that engineers, researchers, and senior leaders can act on; communicate progress, limitations, risks, and dependencies clearly. - Connect national lab researchers with OpenAI Research, Product, and Engineering teams to assess promising scientific applications and move feasible opportunities into scoped, supported projects. - Coordinate the Applied AI Architect, specialist engineers, and customer technical teams on architecture, data access, evaluation, integration, and deployment requirements. - Build sustained adoption through practical enablement, user feedback, workflow support, and repeatable playbooks that can be applied across labs and other science agencies. - Lead executive reviews and focused workshops in Washington and at customer sites, bringing the right decision-makers and technical experts together to resolve issues and advance delivery. - Identify security, data, infrastructure, contractual, and resourcing risks early; work with the accountable teams to resolve them and escalate decisions promptly. - Prioritize across a small, matrixed team, make clear trade-offs, and maintain momentum as customer needs and model capabilities evolve. - Coordinate with the Account Director, policy colleagues, and partners on broader DOE and science engagement, while keeping delivery commitments aligned with available resources and approved capabilities. YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 10+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, customer delivery, or transformation initiatives, including substantial work with DOE, U.S. national labs, or comparable federal science institutions. - Can meet customer-specific access requirements. An active DOE Q and/or U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance is preferred for engagements involving national security missions. - Are willing to travel domestically when an in-person engagement materially advances customer priorities, relationships, or delivery; use Washington-based engagement and remote collaboration effectively. - Understand DOE headquarters, the national lab ecosystem, and how government sponsors, lab management, researchers, and technical teams make decisions and deliver work. - Have led complex AI/ML, enterprise software, API, cloud, scientific computing, or digital transformation engagements through implementation and sustained adoption. - Bring executive presence and a record of influencing senior government and laboratory leaders, while remaining personally accountable for follow-through with working teams. - Translate scientific and mission goals into practical execution plans, acceptance criteria, and measures such as workflow adoption, researcher productivity, output quality, and time to a validated result. - Have enough technical fluency to evaluate AI use cases, challenge assumptions, and work credibly with architects and researchers on data integration, model evaluation, and deployment trade-offs. - Are curious about frontier AI and actively experiment with the technology to understand its capabilities, limitations, and applications to scientific work. - Build durable partnerships across scientists, engineers, security teams, program owners, and executives; thrive in ambiguity and take initiative in a fast-moving environment. - See yourself as a bridge between frontier AI research and practical scientific impact, with the judgment to distinguish a promising demonstration from a validated result. - Help customers use AI responsibly, with appropriate data protection, human review, provenance, reproducibility, and scientific validation. - Existing relationships across DOE and the national labs, experience with NNSA, and familiarity with NASA or NSF are valuable. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. items.title: Applied AI Architects, Partner
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners (AWS and GCP). You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy. Key Responsibilities Strategic Technical Partnership : Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues. Joint Solution Development: Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment Customer Deal Support: Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance. Partner Ecosystem & Events : Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, AWS summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities. Product Feedback: Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy. Preferred qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Fluent in Korean and English Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Growth Engineering team builds the experiences that connect people to our ecosystem for the first time — and keeps them coming back. We design and ship the systems behind our marketing funnels, signup and KYC flows, and the key engagement features that help new users fund their accounts and explore our products. It’s a team with direct influence on company growth, global reach, and user engagement at scale. Our products serve millions of users globally. HOW WE WORK - We give engineers ownership and trust them to ship high-impact work with craftsmanship and accountability. - We move quickly, experiment often, and learn fast from data and feedback. - We work asynchronously across time zones, supporting each other with open communication and shared goals. items.title: Head of Field Operations, EMEA
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Lead a growing business operations field partnership team that helps regional sales leaders turn business insight into focused execution and sustainable growth. You will partner with three regional VPs across Northern, Central and Southern Europe, supporting approximately 50–60 account executives. You will develop the team’s ability to advise leaders, solve commercial problems and drive action. Global Revenue Operations provides pipeline analytics and business insight. Your team will translate those insights into regional priorities, practical interventions and measurable results, with clear ownership and consistent follow-through. You will also work closely with GTM Systems, gathering feedback from sellers and sales leaders to identify process gaps and opportunities for AI and automation that reduce manual work and help teams move faster. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Lead and develop the team. Coach and prioritize the work of a growing business operations field partnership team, with clear regional coverage, accountability and development plans. 2. Partner with regional leadership. Translate EMEA growth objectives into quarterly priorities, market focus, account coverage and resource allocation. 3. Own territory planning and execution. Lead territory design, rollout and ongoing management with Sales and global RevOps; align account allocation to market potential, seller capacity and ramp, and resolve coverage gaps. 4. Drive capacity and quota planning. Partner with Sales, Finance and global RevOps on headcount, capacity and regional quotas; translate plans into territory targets and track attainment. 5. Shape regional pipeline targets. Advocate for pipeline creation and coverage targets with Sales, Marketing and global RevOps; track progress and drive recovery plans where gaps emerge. 6. Run the regional operating cadence. Lead weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews that produce decisions, owners and deadlines; track performance, escalate blockers and close out actions. 7. Strengthen forecast discipline. Challenge assumptions with sales leaders and managers, inspect changes and surface risks, slippage and upside early. 8. Turn insight into action. Interpret global analytics in regional context, diagnose root causes, agree interventions and measure results. Feed field context and unanswered questions back to global RevOps. 9. Improve productivity through AI and automation. Gather seller and leadership feedback, prioritize opportunities with GTM Systems, define requirements, pilot improvements and measure adoption, time saved and execution speed. 10. Deliver cross-functional change. Represent EMEA in global initiatives and coordinate regional adoption with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Enablement and GTM Systems. Equip managers to embed improvements in daily execution. MUST-HAVES - Experience leading and developing sales operations, revenue operations or commercial business partnership teams. - A track record of translating analysis into action and measurable results. - Credibility with senior sales leaders and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority. - Strong commercial judgment across territories, capacity, quotas, pipeline, forecasting and seller productivity. - Experience delivering cross-functional improvements in a growing B2B technology business. NICE-TO-HAVES - Experience supporting multiple European markets. - Experience leading through rapid organizational growth. FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS - Analytical problem solving. - Clear communication and constructive challenge. - Prioritization, ownership and follow-through. - Coaching and delegation. - Process improvement and AI/automation judgment. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - Regional leaders have clear priorities backed by evidence and practical action plans. - Territories, capacity and quotas are aligned to regional opportunity and field realities. - Pipeline and performance gaps trigger timely interventions with measured outcomes. - Business reviews consistently produce decisions and completed follow-up. - Business partners earn leaders’ trust and operate with increasing independence. - Seller feedback leads to adopted process improvements that save time and accelerate execution. - Regional feedback improves global priorities, and global initiatives are used effectively in the field. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. items.title: Principal Technical SEO Specialist (Legend)
items.description: About Legend Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising. Learn more at l1.com . Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company. Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive. The Role Legend is hiring a Principal Technical SEO, reporting directly to our Chief Gaming Officer. This is a rare opportunity to take portfolio-wide responsibility for the technical SEO performance of some of the largest and most commercially important domains in iGaming. Working alongside our existing Principal Technical SEO, you will co-own technical SEO across our Gaming portfolio, while also supporting our Sports portfolio. You will identify the technical opportunities and risks that matter most, turn them into clear priorities, and work closely with Product and Engineering to deliver measurable organic and commercial impact. This is a deeply hands-on role where you will solve complex challenges across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, internationalisation, migrations and performance, while setting standards that scale across our portfolio. You will also play a key role in advancing how we use AI and automation across SEO. You will build tools, monitoring, diagnostics and automated workflows yourself, using technology to improve the speed and quality of decision-making and helping our wider SEO teams adopt these capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant autonomy and visibility. You will lead through expertise rather than formal authority, working alongside senior specialists and leaders across SEO, Product, Engineering and Analytics to shape decisions across the organisation. In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed. Your Impact: Co-own our portfolio-wide technical SEO strategy, roadmap and standards, identifying and prioritising the opportunities and risks with the greatest potential organic and commercial impact. Lead complex technical investigations across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, international SEO, migrations, structured data and web performance. Partner with Product and Engineering on architecture, major releases, migrations and experimentation, translating technical SEO insights into clear priorities and scalable solutions. Build automated monitoring, diagnostics and early-warning systems that identify material technical issues before they become significant commercial problems. Develop internal tools and AI-enabled workflows that improve analysis, quality assurance, prioritisation and execution across technical SEO and the wider SEO organisation. Create reusable technical patterns, guardrails and frameworks across our portfolio, raising technical capability through coaching, documentation and shared tooling. What You'll Bring: Repeated technical SEO impact at scale - a strong track record of personally leading complex technical SEO initiatives across large websites or multi-domain portfolios, with clear evidence of measurable organic or commercial outcomes. Exceptional technical SEO depth and judgement - expert knowledge across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, canonicalisation, international SEO, migrations, structured data, JavaScript SEO, log-file analysis and web performance, with the judgement to separate material opportunities from technical hygiene. Commercial and strategic thinking - able to translate complex technical findings into priorities based on expected value, risk, effort, confidence and opportunity cost, connecting technical decisions to organic and commercial outcomes. Principal-level influence - experienced in influencing Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders without direct authority, challenging constructively and communicating complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. A builder's mindset - intellectually curious, technically self-sufficient and comfortable remaining deeply hands-on while creating systems, standards and capabilities that increase the impact of teams beyond your own individual contribution. The Interview Process: 1st: Initial chat with our Talent Partner - 30 minutes via Zoom. 2nd: Interview with our Chief Gaming Officer - 60 minutes via Zoom. 3rd: Technical SEO interview with senior members of our SEO team - 60 minutes via Zoom. 4th: Case presentation and Principal peer interview - 90 minutes via Zoom, including a technical SEO assessment prepared ahead of the interview.

items.title: Member of Technical Staff (New Grad)
items.description: Welcome! This is the general application portal for university students and recent graduates who wish to be considered for full-time Member of Technical Staff positions at Perplexity. Our elite new grad cohorts enjoy unparalleled mentorship, top-of-market compensation, and the chance to tackle some of the deepest, thorniest challenges in frontier intelligence https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/category/research. NOTE: if you attend one of our focus schools listed below, please do not apply via this portal as it is infrequently monitored due to high volume. Apply instead via the school-specific application portal below to ensure your application receives priority attention. FOCUS SCHOOLS (UNITED STATES) - APPLICATION PORTALS Caltech https://pplx.ai/2026Caltech | Columbia https://pplx.ai/2026Columbia | Cornell https://pplx.ai/2026Cornell | CMU https://pplx.ai/2026CMU | Duke https://pplx.ai/2026Duke | Georgia Tech https://pplx.ai/2026GATech Harvard https://pplx.ai/2026Harvard | MIT https://pplx.ai/2026MIT | Michigan https://pplx.ai/2026Michigan | Northwestern https://pplx.ai/2026Northwestern | NYU https://pplx.ai/2026NYU | Penn https://pplx.ai/2026Penn Princeton https://pplx.ai/2026Princeton | Purdue https://pplx.ai/2026Purdue | Stanford https://pplx.ai/2026Stanford | UC Berkeley https://pplx.ai/2026Berkeley | UChicago https://pplx.ai/2026UChicago UCLA https://pplx.ai/2026UCLA | UIUC https://pplx.ai/2026UIUC | UNC Chapel Hill https://pplx.ai/2026UNC | UT Austin https://pplx.ai/2026UTAustin UWashington https://pplx.ai/2026UW | Yale https://pplx.ai/2026Yale FOCUS SCHOOLS (CANADA) - APPLICATION PORTALS McGill https://pplx.ai/2026McGill | UBC https://pplx.ai/2026UBC | UToronto https://pplx.ai/2026UToronto | Waterloo https://pplx.ai/2026Waterloo EARLY CAREER TALENT @ PERPLEXITY Perplexity believes that exceptionally talented individuals at any stage can thrive in our high-velocity, high-ownership culture. Our early career talent program revolves around: - Breadth: New grads at Perplexity work across the stack, from Perplexity's agent harnesses to our AI inference and training systems. Many of our most beloved features and most important systems were shipped by individuals fresh out of school. - Depth: New grads are entrusted (and expected) to dive deep into whatever problem domains you work on. Often, your work will require you to become a world expert in some problem space that few others in the world have encountered. - Mentorship & Growth: We keep the size of our entering new grad cohorts at well below 10% of our technical team. Each individual enjoys a rich network of mentors to help them grow, and our new grads have a track record of becoming some of Perplexity's most senior and prolific team members. - Recognition: We select for the best and we recognize them accordingly. We set our early career compensation to rise well above that of top tech companies and startups. Post-hire, we aggressively recognize and reward growth in role. - Mission: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. Our mission is to build frontier intelligence for the world's most discerning users, and each contribution you make will directly advance that mission. ACADEMIC REQUIREMENTS If you're not applying from a focus school listed above, we typically require you to possess the following qualifications: 1. GPA of ≥3.92, averaged across all CS and Math classes; and 2. Grade of A or A+ in your school's upper-level algorithms course. Additional advanced coursework in areas such as systems, AI/ML, advanced math, and other rigorous subjects is highly welcome. NON-QUALIFYING APPLICATIONS - EVIDENCE OF EXCEPTIONAL ABILITY While you're welcome to submit your application if you don't meet these criteria, we will be looking for other evidence of exceptional ability. You are encouraged to briefly describe this evidence in response to the "Anything Else" question at the bottom of the application form. NOTE ON FELLOWSHIP OPPORTUNITIES This portal accepts applications for full-time roles at Perplexity. Internship applications are not accepted via this portal. If you're interested in short-term opportunities with our team, you may instead be interested in the Perplexity Research Fellowship. The Fellowship has a separate application process detailed here https://pplx.ai/fellowship. Note that Fellowship applications are extremely competitive; in particular, we don't expect to admit any undergraduate students to the Fellowship before their final year of study.

You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth. This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption. - Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams. - Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving. - Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage. - Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption, assess results against agreed baselines, and communicate the value achieved. - Provide a clear view of delivery health. Lead customer and internal delivery reviews that drive decisions and action. Communicate progress, launch confidence, risks, and implications for expected consumption and revenue timing. - Improve how we deliver. Turn customer experience into repeatable playbooks, practical tools, and actionable feedback for product and delivery teams. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise technology deployments, customer delivery programs, or transformation initiatives involving multiple teams and partners. - A track record of driving programs from scope through launch and adoption, with accountability for delivery commitments and measurable customer outcomes. - Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand AI systems, APIs, integrations, enterprise architecture, security dependencies, and deployment risks. - The ability to translate customer priorities into actionable delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures. - Strong judgment under ambiguity, including the ability to identify material risks, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions. - Experience building trust with customers and leading across teams outside your reporting line while holding stakeholders accountable to shared commitments. - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, technical specialists, and customer operators and explain complex delivery issues clearly. - Commercial awareness and an understanding of how deployment, adoption, and consumption contribute to customer value and growth. - A practical approach to building repeatable delivery methods while adapting to the needs of individual About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Beneficial Deployments: Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most. About the Role: We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments team, focused on maximizing the impact of Claude in the life sciences. Our goal is ambitious: accelerate scientific progress from R&D through translation by an order of magnitude. That means making Claude the go-to tool for the life sciences ecosystem from early discovery in academia to paradigm shifting biotech to reimaging pharma pipelines — and building the technical infrastructure to back that up. You'll work directly with flagship research partners like Howard Hughes Medical Institute and The Allen Institute, embedded in their scientific workflows. This isn't consulting from the outside — you'll be building alongside their engineers, prototyping agents that fit into real research pipelines, and developing the ecosystem-level tooling (MCP servers, benchmarks, reusable agent skills) that extends Claude's usefulness across the broader life sciences community. This role will be part of the founding Beneficial Deployments applied AI team focused on bringing more of life sciences closer to the frontier and be responsible for building with our partners. Responsibilities: Partner deeply with flagship life sciences research institutions — understand their scientific workflows end-to-end, build hands-on with their engineering teams, and help take projects from early exploration to production systems integrated into how they do science day-to-day. Develop reusable ecosystem infrastructure, like MCP servers for domain-specific data sources (genomics platforms, literature databases, experimental repositories), instruments, scientifically-grounded benchmarks, and agent skills that other institutions can adopt without starting from scratch. Identify what's actually hard about deploying AI in life sciences (heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, the prototype-to-trust gap) and feed those findings back to product, engineering, and research. Create technical content and documentation that lets partners self-serve, so what works for one institution can scale globally without the same level of hand-holding. You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have: 4+ years as a Software Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder — with production experience shipping systems that real users depend on. Deep research experience in life sciences, biomedical research, or scientific computing. Bonus if you've studied genomics, neuroscience, or drug discovery specifically and are comfortable getting deeply technical with academics. Experience building LLM-powered tools or applications: prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks. Builder credibility from shipping production code as a software engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or technical founder. A scrappy mentality–comfortable wearing multiple hats, building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and doing whatever it takes to further the mission. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Engineering Manager, AI Platform & Agentic Apps
items.department: ENG Data and AI Platform Division
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. ABOUT THE TEAM + ROLE We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The AI Platform & Agentic Apps team builds the agent platform behind every AI agent at Robinhood — today giving a growing number of engineers and employees an AI teammate that ships code, queries data, and runs operational workflows on their behalf. We're building toward the same platform powering the agents millions of customers interact with directly, in real time. These agents don't just answer questions; they're designed to take real action across carefully curated meta harnesses. This is agentic AI at real scale, in a regulated financial environment, and it will change how Robinhood works. We move fast, raise the bar, and care deeply about building things that matter! As Engineering Manager, you will lead the charge in developing critical infrastructure for Agentic applications spanning Robinhood products. You will guide the engineering organization in leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to create real, scalable products that act in the world on behalf of Robinhood's customers and employees. This role calls for a visionary leader with a strong software engineering background, a passion for developing platforms, and deep expertise in applied ML at scale. You'll partner closely with Legal, Compliance, and Security to build agents that can be trusted to act in a regulated brokerage environment — driving everything from eval-gated releases to audit trails that hold up under scrutiny. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. items.title: QA Engineer
items.description: ComeOn Group in short Founded in 2008, ComeOn Group is a leading global player in the rapidly growing iGaming market. Having launched its first online brand in 2010, ComeOn Group is running a wide range of exciting brands across multiple markets. Operating more than 20 brands on its proprietary platform providing a secure, innovative and entertainment-led player experience across casino and sports betting. ComeOn Group is an international employer within the iGaming industry and has over 600 talented employees across 7 main locations. Location: Graz, Austria on a hybrid office policy We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our team and ensure the quality and performance of our online sportsbook platform. You will be responsible for testing new features, identifying issues, and working closely with developers and product teams to deliver a seamless betting experience for our users. Requirements: 7+ years of experience in QA testing, preferably in sports betting, gaming, or fintech. Take full responsibility for developing and executing manual and automated test cases for sportsbook functionalities, including betting markets, odds updates, in-play events and risk management. Creation of test strategies, test plans, test schedules, sign-off documents with focus and maintenance of quality standards and validation techniques. Strong understanding of sportsbook platforms, betting markets, and in-play event handling. Identify, document, and track bugs using JIRA (or similar tools). Perform functional, regression and performance testing across our sportsbook backend and frontend. Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality releases. Validate data accuracy, betting calculations, and compliance with industry regulations. Work within an Agile/Scrum framework to support sprint releases. Desired Skills: Experience with SQL for data validation. Experience with API/swagger. Experience with test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress). Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control (e.g., Git, Jenkins). Passion for sports betting and an understanding of customer behaviors. Hands-on testing (Functional, Integration and UI) Experience with JIRA and TestRail or similar test management tools. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks. Nice to Have: Experience working in a high-traffic, real-time gaming or betting environment. Knowledge of compliance requirements in regulated markets. Exposure to performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling). REST-API testing using RestAssured or Postman Competencies: Strong communicator Attention to details Team player Problem solving Curious Technology Stack for testing: Jira, Postman, SQL, Report portal, Jenkins, GitHub, BrowserStack, Lambdatest, Kibana, GrafanaAutomation: Cypress, WDIO, RestAssured Why Join ComeOn! At ComeOn!, you'll be part of a collaborative, fast-moving environment where your work has a direct impact on how our teams deliver products loved by millions of users. Cozy office in the new and modern district of Graz, located in the Reininghaus Grounds. Breakfast at the office every Monday. Fun company events and team activities. A one-time allowance of 250 EUR to help you set up a comfortable workstation at home. On top of our Hybrid work arrangement, up to 40 days a year to work fully remote from anywhere. Brand new laptop. Massage in the Office on Wednesdays. A great relocation package. Annual public transportation ticket (KlimaTicket Steiermark). Company bike leasing - ComeOn eases a (an electric) company bike and provisions it to the employee for use. At the end of the lease term, the employee is free to purchase the employer-provisioned company bike at its residual value. Want to work from the office a few days a week and some days from home? That’s totally fine with us! ComeOn is known for its inviting and vibrant offices that offer creative areas for collaboration and desk set-ups designed for a Hybrid Work model. When you visit one of our offices you will always be welcomed by a friendly face that will take good care of you. It’s our curiosity that drives our innovative business forward and we work hard in a run together spirit and we always make sure to top it up by having fun! You will not regret picking ComeOn as your next place of work. At ComeOn Group we value diversity and we take concrete action to ensure fairness in our recruitment process. We are committed to assess candidates on their merit without discriminating against any applicant for whatever reason that is protected by law. We truly value you, as you are. And because we truly believe in the potential of the people who join us, some interns choose to continue their journey with Betclic after their internship. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? items.title: AI Support Engineer - Toronto (Weekend Shift)
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. About the Role We’re looking for dedicated, experienced, and deeply curious individuals to help solve some of the most complex challenges faced by our customers while building the future of post-AGI support alongside us. In this role, you’ll work directly with customers through support tickets and live calls, troubleshooting high-impact issues and resolving novel, often ambiguous technical problems in one of the fastest-moving environments in technology. As AI adoption rapidly accelerates, the work you do will directly support mission-critical systems being built on OpenAI’s platform, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale. Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale. Note: each person in this role will be expected to work a standard 5x8 work week, with 1 of the days covering weekend shifts each week (e.g., work weeks covering Tuesday - Saturday or Sunday - Thursday) You’ll be responsible for: - Working directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, and production incidents. Providing end-to-end ownership through debugging logs, analyzing system behavior, reproducing issues, and delivering expert guidance. - Becoming a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and platform, serving as a go-to resource for complex technical issues. - Serving as a critical escalation point and line of defense for complex technical issues, partnering closely with customers and Engineering teams to troubleshoot, resolve, and proactively prevent recurring problems while leveraging scripting and emerging AI capabilities to improve internal tooling and automate operational workflows - Taking learnings from resolving customer issues and creating our approach to scaling these solutions, partnering with Product and Go-To-Market teams. - Driving operational excellence by identifying opportunities for automation and AI-powered workflows, implementing scalable improvements that increase team efficiency, reducing manual effort, and elevating the overall support experience. - Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Have 8+ years of experience in User Operations, Engineering, Support Engineering or similar technical roles, ideally within high-growth tech startups or other fast-paced environments. - Are comfortable using emerging technologies (ie. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) to script or engineer code (e.g., Python) for automating repetitive tasks and integrating tools. - Have expert-level SaaS troubleshooting skills with the ability to rapidly understand new technologies and complex concepts. - Polished enterprise communication and are calm with high-stakes customers during live incident calls - Proven experience building strong relationships with customers and cross-functional partners to drive resolution to complex issues. - Exceptional critical thinker and problem solver with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical issues to both customers and internal teams. - Thrive in ambiguity, adapt rapidly to change, continuously learn, and proactively seek opportunities for growth. - Bring a humble, team first mindset, a genuine eagerness to help others, and the curiosity to quickly learn whatever knowledge is needed to help both your teammates and our customers succeed. - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, another relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
