items.title: Project / Product Manager — PSP & Payment Integrations
items.description: ABOUT OUR CLIENT Our client is a fintech company building payment infrastructure and AI-powered solutions for international markets. The company works with dozens of payment providers and payment methods, a large number of merchants, and multiple regions. The team is currently working on two major tracks: bringing the company’s internal processes into a single platform and launching new product directions in neobanking and crypto processing. Both require someone who can turn ideas into a structured plan — and that plan into a working product. TRACK 1: INTERNAL PLATFORM — PRODUCT + PROJECT WHAT WE ARE BUILDING - An internal CRM for Sales, BizDev, Legal, and Compliance: merchant and provider profiles, deal pipelines and statuses, KYB/KYC and compliance checklists, approval workflows, contracts, pricing, payment method and MID registries, roles, and access permissions. - A transaction management and processing system: a single source of truth for transaction data, statuses, reconciliation, fee calculations, and settlements. - Payment dashboards for management and internal teams: turnover, conversion, decline reasons, and provider/merchant performance. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run discovery sessions with internal stakeholders across Sales, BizDev, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Operations, turning their requests into requirements, flows, and priorities. - Independently create prototypes using AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Figma AI, or similar tools — clickable screens, forms, and dashboards — and show stakeholders how the solution will work before it goes into development. - Build and own the roadmap for the internal platform and present it to management. - Manage the backlog in Jira, decompose initiatives, plan through Jira Plans, and control delivery through release. - Work with the technical team to define data models and dashboard metrics and ensure that the numbers in the system match reality. - Maintain Confluence documentation as a single source of truth. TRACK 2: NEW PRODUCTS — NEOBANKING & CRYPTO PROCESSING WHAT WE ARE BUILDING Neobanking: accounts, IBANs, cards, payments, customer onboarding, and integrations with BaaS/licensed partners. Crypto Processing: crypto deposits and payouts, on/off-ramp, wallets, conversion, blockchain confirmations, and integrations with custody and liquidity providers. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Work with the Product Owner to turn product hypotheses into a product plan: MVP scope, stages, milestones, and success criteria. - Quickly build prototypes when needed using AI/no-code tools to show developers and stakeholders what needs to be built instead of relying only on lengthy written descriptions. - Build development plans covering estimates, resources, dependencies, critical paths, and timelines. - Own delivery across the development team, QA, and external partners, including licensing, BaaS, and crypto providers. - Manage non-technical dependencies, including licensing, compliance, and contractual requirements, and identify potential launch blockers in advance. - Manage risks and scope changes and provide transparent status updates to management. - Take the product through to its first real transaction and post-launch stabilization. WHAT IS CRITICAL FOR US 1. STRONG PROJECT MANAGEMENT IN PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT - 4+ years of experience managing product development — not only outsourced projects based on predefined specifications, but products with an in-house team and ownership of decisions. - Advanced Jira skills: Epics, Tasks, Links, Workflows, and Jira Plans. - Experience with planning, estimates, dependency management, risk management, and scope changes. - Experience managing multiple development streams simultaneously. - Structured and transparent documentation in Confluence. 2. PRODUCT THINKING FOR INTERNAL SYSTEMS - Ability to run discovery, ask the right questions, and propose solutions rather than simply document requirements. - Understanding of systems built for operational teams: workflows, roles, permissions, approvals, and audit trails. - Ability to prioritize what should be built, why, and in what order. 3. TECHNICAL UNDERSTANDING — NO CODING REQUIRED - Ability to read API documentation and understand requests/responses, webhooks, authentication, and sandbox/staging/production environments. - Understanding of product data models and ability to validate data independently — SQL at a confident reading level. - Understanding of how systems integrate and where data inconsistencies may occur. 4. STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT You will work with multiple internal stakeholders with different priorities, management, and external partners. You should be able to align people, maintain priorities, and keep the team focused. 5. AI PROTOTYPING - Ability to independently build working prototypes — screens, forms, flows, dashboards — using Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Bolt, Figma AI, or similar tools within hours rather than days. - Use prototypes as a communication tool: show stakeholders what they will get and developers what needs to be built when written requirements are not enough. - Understand that a prototype is used to remove uncertainty and align stakeholders — not to replace the development team. - Actively use AI for analysis, documentation, and project management in your daily work. A MAJOR PLUS - Experience in payments / fintech: PSPs, payment integrations, transaction lifecycle, reconciliation. - Neobanking, BaaS, core banking, ledger/accounts/wallets. - Crypto: on/off-ramp, custody, blockchain integrations. - KYB/KYC/AML processes and compliance workflows. - High-risk industries: iGaming, betting, forex, crypto. - BI tools such as Grafana, Metabase, Looker, or Power BI. - Experience creating a prototype that was later developed and became part of a real product.

items.title: Recruiter, Go-To-Market (GTM)
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. Anthropic is seeking an experienced GTM Recruiter to join our recruiting team. In this role, you'll partner closely with GTM leaders to hire the people who will shape how Anthropic operates, grows, and delivers on its mission. This role requires someone who can assess not just functional expertise, but also alignment with our values and the adaptability required to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Responsibilities: Lead end to end recruiting for GTM roles Develop and execute strategic recruiting plans, including competitive mapping, targeted sourcing, and building long-term talent pipelines Build trusted partnerships with GTM leadership to understand business priorities, team structures, ideal candidate profiles, and required competencies across different functions Create exceptional candidate experiences that showcase Anthropic's mission, growth trajectory, and unique growth opportunity for GTM professionals Design and implement scalable recruiting processes that effectively assess functional expertise, business acumen, and cultural alignment Track recruiting metrics and use data to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and maintain a high-quality hiring bar Coach hiring managers on recruiting best practices, interview techniques, and strategies for building diverse, high-performing teams You may be a good fit if you: Have 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with meaningful exposure to GTM functions Are comfortable working in ambiguous environments and help hiring teams build structure and excellent recruiting practices Have strong stakeholder management skills - you can share examples of frameworks you've built that drive hiring while coaching teams to improve their recruiting Are highly organized with strong attention to detail - you stay on top of data integrity and maintain regular touchpoints with candidates and hiring managers Are comfortable analyzing recruiting data and can connect key metrics to monitor recruiting health and maintain a great hiring experience Are passionate about AI's potential to positively impact the world while understanding its risks and limitations Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.location_text: United Kingdom, Brazil, United Arab Emirates, Ireland, Peru, Sweden, Colombia, Argentina, Romania, Cyprus, Switzerland, Portugal, Lithuania, South Africa, Czech Republic, Canada, Hungary, Mexico, Chile, Poland, Spain, Bulgaria
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. You’ll work directly with the AI Growth Infrastructure Lead, the Growth Workflow Specialists across channels, and the domain experts who spec the workflows you build. You’ll operate within the Growth Foundations Group — the centralized team that builds the engine every product team in the business runs on. THE ROLE We’re building an AI-native growth engine — one where agents make distribution decisions, creative is generated and iterated at scale, and the system compounds intelligence across every product simultaneously. This is not automation bolted onto existing workflows. It is a new model entirely. As AI Engineer, Growth, you will be the second builder on this engine. Working alongside our lead architect, you execute — building, shipping, and iterating the agent orchestrations, automated workflows, and system integrations that power every growth work-stream: paid growth, lifecycle, organic search, CRO, incentives, referrals, and beyond. This role is for someone who moves fast, builds from specs without needing hand-holding, and cares deeply about the quality of what they ship. If you’ve spent your career wanting to build systems that actually run growth rather than just support it — this is that role. THE OPPORTUNITY WHAT YOU’LL BUILD • Agent orchestration workflows across growth use cases — automating the decisions and executions that today require human intervention across paid media, lifecycle messaging, organic content, conversion optimization, incentives, and other growth levers • Integrations between our AI reasoning layer, growth execution platforms, data infrastructure, experimentation systems, and analytics tools • Shared agent infrastructure components — reusable workflow patterns, prompt libraries, and integration clients that every growth workstream draws from • Monitoring and audit logging — ensuring every agent action is traceable, versioned, and queryable for governance and continuous improvement • Creative and content generation pipelines — automating the brief-to-variant-to-distribution loop across growth channels WHAT YOU’LL OWN • Build velocity across new growth workstreams — you are the person who gets workflows from spec to production • Integration reliability — connections between systems work, handle errors gracefully, and are maintained as tools evolve • Workflow documentation — every workflow you build is documented clearly enough that a domain specialist can understand, tune, and improve it without your involvement WHAT YOU BRING • 3+ years building automation workflows, integrations, or agentic systems — using AI orchestration platforms, workflow automation tools, or equivalent technologies • Strong understanding of API integrations — REST, webhooks, authentication patterns, and error handling at scale • Experience working with LLM APIs — prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool use, and agent chaining • Comfort working from a spec — you can take a workflow design and build it accurately without the architect in the room • Growth or marketing context — you understand what you’re building toward, not just how to build it • Speed and quality in balance — you ship fast and you care what you ship NICE TO HAVES • Experience with paid media platforms, marketing automation, CRM, or lifecycle messaging systems • Familiarity with data warehouse query patterns and event tracking infrastructure • Background in a high-growth fintech, consumer tech, or multi-product technology environment • Experience designing multi-agent architectures or complex agent-to-agent workflows Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
